summary: Syntactically valid with correct imports and a functioning agent-based mask adoption core, but it diverges from the provided specification in multiple major ways: policy scheduling is not implemented, many required parameters are ignored, and numerous required metrics are missing. Logic is reasonable for a simplified model, but key spec elements (policy schedule with end date, group metrics, campaign lift, risk signal usage, etc.) are absent.

issues.description: The simulation does not implement the policy_schedule with start_day and end_day; mandates become active once and never end. Enforcement is a constant level rather than scheduled.
issues.solution: Add a policy_schedule list to PolicyAuthority that supports multiple windows (start_day, end_day, level). In step(), determine mandate_active by checking if t is within any schedule window, and expose enforcement probability and penalty per policy level.

issues.description: Many required metrics are missing: adoption_rate_by_group (age/income/ideology), time_to_50_percent, peak_adoption, sustained_adoption_post_policy, policy_compliance_rate, adoption_churn_rate, network_clustering_of_adoption, campaign_lift, and risk_correlation.
issues.solution: Track group-wise adoption (by age/income/ideology), compute time to 50%, peak adoption and day, post-policy sustained adoption (30 days after last mandate ends), compliance rate while mandates in effect, churn (fraction switching states day-to-day), clustering/modularity of adoption on the network, campaign lift via a no-campaign counterfactual or on/off periods, and correlation of adoption with an external risk signal.

issues.description: Specification parameters are not honored: simulation_duration_days/time_step_days are ignored (uses simulation_days), homophily_strength and conformity_threshold unused, peer_influence_strength/media_influence_strength/authority_influence_strength not parameterized, risk_signal_mode/time_series unused.
issues.solution: Normalize 'simulation_duration_days' to 'simulation_days' and support 'time_step_days'. Use homophily_strength to influence network topology (e.g., assortative mixing). Add explicit weights for peer/media/authority influence to decision logic. Wire risk_signal_time_series into daily risk_perception updates when risk_signal_mode='exogenous'.

issues.description: Entity attribute coverage is incomplete vs. spec: Person lacks ideology, education_level, trust_in_media, perceived_mask_effectiveness, daily_schedule, network_neighbors fields. MediaChannel is simplified and lacks scheduling/campaign intensity. SocialNetwork object is not represented explicitly.
issues.solution: Extend Person to include ideology, education_level, trust_in_media, perceived_mask_effectiveness, daily_schedule, and a cached network_neighbors list. Implement MediaChannel with schedule and campaign_intensity and misinformation_rate consistent with spec. Optionally wrap networkx graph in a SocialNetwork class to propagate social influence.

issues.description: Adoption decision does not incorporate perceived_mask_effectiveness or a conformity threshold, and updates risk/trust only via media (no peer belief updates).
issues.solution: Add perceived_mask_effectiveness to the decision utility, apply a conformity threshold (e.g., step or sigmoid around the peer adoption rate), and implement peer-based belief updates (update_beliefs_from_peers) using neighbor mask states and tie weights.

issues.description: Media campaigns and misinformation per spec are not implemented (no schedule, targeting, or intensity modulation).
issues.solution: Implement campaign schedules from cfg['media_campaigns'] with start/end and intensity; adjust message_bias and reach dynamically; include misinformation_intensity; support target audience segments by ideology/age/income.

issues.description: Mandate enforcement and location policy are simplistic: no location-level mask requirement toggling or enforcement-strictness per spec.
issues.solution: Add mask_policy_enforced and enforcement_strictness per location; during mandate windows, set per-location enforcement based on PolicyAuthority and location configuration; affect entry and compliance probability accordingly.

issues.description: Adoption-by-group metric for ideology cannot be computed because 'ideology' is absent.
issues.solution: Add an 'ideology' attribute, initialize it (e.g., via a distribution with homophily), and compute adoption_rate_by_group segmented by age/income/ideology.

issues.description: The main() function is a no-op. While the required global call exists, it does not run a simulation or provide outputs.
issues.location: main() at file top and final call
issues.solution: Optionally implement main() to parse configuration (e.g., from env/JSON), run Simulation(cfg).run(), and print/save results. The direct call pattern can remain as required.

issues.description: Average degree for scale-free topology ignores 'average_degree' (uses BA parameter m_ba=3).
issues.solution: Map average_degree to BA parameter m (e.g., m = max(1, average_degree // 2)) when network_topology is scale_free.

issues.description: Location lookup by id is O(n) per contact pass because locations are stored in lists and searched linearly.
issues.solution: Pre-index locations by type and id into dictionaries for O(1) access (e.g., self.locations_by_type_index[type][id] = Location).

issues.description: Some randomness uses the global random module instead of the instance RNG, which may complicate reproducibility in embedded contexts.
issues.solution: Use the Simulation's seeded RNG consistently (self.rng) across all random draws.
